description_expanded: OverviewGulf Views - Pet Friendly - Across the Street from the Public Beach! 4 Bikes! - `InconSEAvable`The Space Classic Florida Beach Home – Gulf Views & Pet-Friendly! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Stunning Gulf Views from Balconies – Enjoy breathtaking sunrises & sunsets Community Pool - Kick back and relax at the pool just steps away 4 FREE Adult Bikes Included – Cruise along 30A & explore the area Directly Across from the Gulf – Just steps to sugar-white sand beaches Spacious & Family-Friendly Layout – Perfect for large groups or multiple families Pet-Friendly! – $150 pet fee + $500 refundable security deposit. 2 pets Max. Open Concept Living Area with Gulf Views – Kitchen, dining & living spaces flow together Multiple Outdoor Balconies – Relax & take in the fresh coastal breeze Complimentary Wi-Fi & Smart TVs – Stay connected & entertained Parking for 2 Vehicles – Hassle-free & convenient Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacationWelcome to InconSEAvableThis beautiful and classic Florida home is the perfect place to enjoy your family time any time of the year. The gulf view from the balconies are just breath-taking!!The first floor of the home is where you'll find the master bedroom with King bed and private bath, including a standing shower and separate tub. There's also a guest bedroom on the floor, equipped with a twin over full bunk and a queen-sized bed, and a combination shower/tub bathroom.Head on up to the second floor and you'll find the main living space. The kitchen, dining, and living are all open to each other, offering gulf views! There's also a guest bedroom here with a twin over full bunk and a queen bed.On the top floor is the last King guest bedroom and bathroom. The balcony here offers the best gulf views!! Come share your memories with us!!!House Rules**No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**A Few Notes To Keep In Mind-$150 non refundable Pet Fee and $500 Refundable Pet Deposit Required. Please contact our office after booking to add your pets to your reservation.-Guests will be required to be present at the property for any maintenance issues if you are unable to crate or contain your pet.-Walton County does not allow pets on the beach without a permit. In order to obtain a permit, you must be a Walton County resident.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12):-Master: King bed with private bathroom-Guest: King bed with private bathroom-Guest: Queen bed; Twin Over Full Bunk-Guest: Queen bed; Twin Over Full BunkAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.There are two beach accesses within 170 yards from the home in either direction!! However, if you would like to reserve beach chairs the closest beach access is located at Walton Dunes, about 3.4 miles west of 30A. The two closest beach accesses do not allow for public vending.Show less
